lines.text: Many learners say: I will visit my uncle in next week.
Better: I will visit my uncle next week.
Say next week with no in.
Next week! I will visit my uncle next week.

data.wrong: I will visit my uncle in next week.
data.right: I will visit my uncle next week.
data.why: Say next week with no in.
data.memory: I will visit my uncle next week.

native.tip: next week の前に in は不要です。そのまま next week と言います。
native.caption: “I will visit my uncle in next week.”と言っていませんか？😅 「来週に」の「に」につられて in を入れがちです。“I will visit my uncle next week.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“next week”。“I will visit my uncle next week.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.hook: Do you add in before next week?
en.tip: Say next week alone. No in.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I will visit my uncle in next week.” 😅 The Japanese に makes people add in. The natural way is “I will visit my uncle next week.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
